description: The committed predicate-schema hash — the value a canonical world export stamps as `predicateSchemaHash` (schemas/canonical-world-export.schema.json) and a save file carries in its WorldSnapshot. Regenerated by US-1 when the KINP identity surface (id/3 + the identity rule pack) entered the schema, and again by US-2 when the equivalence layer (same_as / based_on + the §4.3 firewall rules) did.
algorithm: sha256 over the newline-joined, canonically sorted `name/arity` list of buildPredicateSchemaSnapshot() — see hashPredicateSchema() in src/prolog/predicate-schema.ts. `kind` is deliberately excluded.
regenerate: write a one-line script importing src/prolog/predicate-schema and printing hashPredicateSchema(buildPredicateSchemaSnapshot()) + the snapshot length, then run it with `npx vite-node <script>` (this vite-node build has no `-e` flag, and tsx is not a dependency). Simpler still: read the value the drift test prints on failure, then commit it together with the schema change.
